**Article Details for PMID: 42977761**

**Title:** Genotoxic safety and long-term engraftment dynamics of efficient translational CRISPR/Cas9 therapeutics for β-haemoglobinopathies from bench to clinical trials.

**Authors:** Abeer M Al-Subaie, J Francis Borgio

**Journal:** Gene therapy
**Publication Date:** 2026-11-03
**DOI:** 10.1038/s41434-026-00656-8
**PMC ID:** 3633182
**Full Text Available:** Yes
**Full Text URL:** https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3633182/


**Abstract:**
CRISPR/Cas9-mediated gene editing targeting the BCL11A erythroid enhancer has transformed therapeutic approaches for transfusion-dependent β-thalassemia (β-thal) and sickle cell disease (SCD). Even though clinical efficacy is well demonstrated, translating these therapies to global patient populations requires a strong evidence-based framework to address critical concerns regarding long-term genotoxic safety and long-lasting engraftment dynamics.
